name: MatterWave Technologies Private Limited
india_angle: MatterWave Technologies is closely linked with IIT Bombay and has developed GaN-based technologies in collaboration with Indian governmental and R&D organizations.
summary: MatterWave Technologies specializes in the design and commercialization of GaN-based RF and power electronics, focusing on rugged semiconductor devices for communication and sensing applications. The company leverages advanced R&D from IIT Bombay to bring innovative GaN technologies to market.
